name: Learning Scriptures
overview: The Scriptures are central to the Christian life as they testify of Christ and reveal the path to eternal life, urging believers to diligently search and embrace them. Abiding in Christ and allowing His words to dwell within empowers believers to pray according to His will and receive answers. Faith itself arises from hearing the Word of God, which is living, powerful, and able to discern the deepest intentions of the heart, guiding believers in truth and spiritual growth.
